headline: Executive order on setting a single national policy approach for artificial intelligence (AI).
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to work toward one national set of policies for artificial intelligence. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, deadlines, and agencies involved are not described here. Readers should check the full text for details.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that build or use AI
who_it_affects.how: A national policy framework could shape the rules these companies follow, but the details are not given in the title.
A national framework may affect how state AI rules relate to federal policy, though the title alone does not say how.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 11, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
